description: This file defines the PluginContext interface for Spark plugins, providing context information and operations such as metrics registration, configuration access, messaging, and RPC calls for plugins loaded by Spark.

classes.name: PluginContext
classes.description: Interface providing context and operations for Spark plugins, including metrics registration, configuration, messaging, and resource info.

methods.name: metricRegistry
methods.description: Returns the registry for plugin metrics.

methods.name: executorID
methods.description: Returns the executor ID, identifying the driver if on the driver node.

methods.name: hostname
methods.description: Returns the hostname used for Spark communication.

methods.name: resources
methods.description: Returns custom resources allocated to the driver or executor.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message to the plugin's driver-side component without expecting a reply.

methods.name: ask
methods.description: Sends an RPC message to the plugin's driver-side component and waits for a reply.
